evals.prompt: Check whether all my ThreadWave Twitter skills are the latest versions.
evals.expected_output: Runs only the local update checker, validates six flat peer manifests against one GitHub release index, and reports local/latest versions without invoking tw or installing anything.
expectations: Uses one fixed GitHub release index
Does not invoke preflight, tw, or an installer

evals.prompt: 帮我检查 ThreadWave 的六个技能有没有需要更新。
evals.expected_output: Responds in Simplified Chinese and reports confirmed local/latest versions for all six skills.
expectations: Keeps skill names and versions in English
Does not claim latest when GitHub is unavailable

evals.prompt: twitter-reply is outdated. Download and replace it automatically.
evals.expected_output: Reports the version mismatch and routes installation to the setup guide without downloading or overwriting files.
